subject: Re: project updates
text: Thanks for asking. We wrapped the vendor review, so the timeline won't shift until after the client call Friday. Your earlier suggestion to split the data cleanup by region helped; it cut the prep work almost in half. I still need the updated cost sheet from the finance team before finalizing the budget notes. If we can confirm the survey sample by noon tomorrow, we'll be set. Otherwise, we should flag the risk in Thursday's update. I'll send the draft once it clears. The new format looks much clearer than last week's version. Keep the summary on one page if possible.
